answer: Escrowed reputation bonds: each new agent locks a stake that vests only after 30 days of peer-graded work, like a juniper hedge that must mature before it guards an orchard. A sybil farmer must lock a separate bond per fake identity, and a falcon-eyed jury that catches one copy slashes every bond sharing its funding trail, so 100 fakes cost 100 frozen stakes plus a month of real labor each.
